building.chernolesye.chernolesye.blacksm: A forge that burns charcoal and bog ore, and the hammer rings until dawn. The Black Forge gives the army first aid tents.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.capitol: The fire in the middle of the hall never goes out, and hide banners hang above the roof. The Eternal Flame brings 4000 gold per day.
A stockade of oak logs with two towers and a moat: hard to take, easy to leave. The Stockade Fort adds two towers, strengthens defence and doubles base creature growth.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.citadel: A taller tower with a palisade and a ditch at its foot. The Watch Tower adds defence and increases creature growth by 50%.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.cityHal: A hall of logs has grown around the fire, where the whole clan gathers. The Ancestral Hearth allows building and brings 2000 gold per day.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.dwellin: An abandoned yard with a half-ruined stove where the złydnie live. The Złydzień Yard allows hiring: Złydnie.
Złydzień Yard
A deep pool in black water, with crooked huts on the bank. The Pool allows hiring: Bołotniki.
The Pool
A den between the roots of old trees, with bones and pelts around. The Wolf Den allows hiring: Wołkołaki.
Wolf Den
A dark grove where trees have grown into walls and idols stand between the roots. The Sacred Grove allows hiring: Leszowie.
Sacred Grove
A wooden shrine with an open-air platform and carved posts. The Circle of Wołchwowie allows hiring: Wołchwowie.
Circle of Wołchwowie
A lonely hut at the forest edge, with dried herbs, bones and charms around. Jaga's Hut allows hiring: Witches.
Jaga's Hut
A sheer cliff with a stone door like a closed eyelid. The Pit of Wij allows hiring: Wije.
Pit of Wij
A crooked canopy was put over the stove, and the złydnie became meaner. The Crooked Yard allows hiring: Elder Złydnie.
Crooked Yard
Huts surround the pool, and the throne of the water lord stands on the bank. The Master's Pool allows hiring: Wodzianoje.
Master's Pool
The den is fenced with stakes and hunting totems. The Pack Den allows hiring: Elder Wołkołaki.
Pack Den
A huge oak has grown in the middle of the grove, and the forest looks alive. The Heart of the Thicket allows hiring: Elder Leszowie.
Heart of the Thicket
The shrine has grown: a stone altar and new posts appeared. The Great Circle allows hiring: Elder Wołchwowie.
Great Circle
A huge hut on chicken legs that walks and fights. Baba Jaga's Hut allows hiring: Baba Jaga.
Baba Jaga's Hut
The hall has half opened its stone eyelid, and light shows inside. The Hall of the Awakened Wij allows hiring: Awakened Wije.
Hall of the Awakened Wij
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.fort.de: A low log tower watches over the bog and the road. The Log Tower gives the town defensive walls.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.grail.d: The stone face of Czarnobog stares from the rock with empty eyes, and people are afraid to look up. The Stone Face of Czarnobog increases weekly creature growth by 50% and brings 5000 gold per day.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.mageGui: An old log well from which quiet voices rise at night. The Well of Dreams lets heroes learn the spells kept inside it.
Carved posts were added around the well, and the voices became clearer. The Well of Dreams lets heroes learn the spells kept inside it.
Lanterns were lit around the well and the water began to glow from within. The Well of Dreams lets heroes learn the spells kept inside it.
A totem with sun signs rose above the well, and the light in the water grew stronger. The Well of Dreams lets heroes learn the spells kept inside it.
A spiral of light wraps the totem, and the well shows visions even by day. The Well of Dreams lets heroes learn the spells kept inside it.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.marketp: A market full of furs, honey, wax, herbs and small iron goods. At the Market Square you can buy and sell resources.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.resourc: A pit where bog ore is dug, and rusty water runs into a stream. The Bog Ore Pit brings +1 ore every day.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.shipyar: Planks and a pier on black water, where boats are tarred. Boats are built at the landing.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.special: A huge grey stone where people leave ribbons and bread for the spirits. Offerings at the Ałatyr Stone please the spirits: +1 morale to the army in the town.
Ancient mounds on a hill and a stone arch between worlds. The Ancestors' Mounds let a hero instantly move to another of his towns.
A crooked inn at a crossroads, lit windows, strange guests at the tables. Heroes can be hired in the inn, and the defenders of the town gain heart. The Crossroads Inn raises the morale of the town's defenders.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.townHal: The fire has grown, and posts with deer antlers stand around it. The Great Bonfire allows building and brings 1000 gold per day.
building.chernolesye.chernolesye.village: A small fire in a ring of stones, where people decide what to build next. The Campfire allows building and brings 500 gold per day.

faction.chernolesye.chernolesye.descript: A gloomy Slavic forest, swamps and evil spirits.
faction.chernolesye.chernolesye.name: Czarnolesie
hero.chernolesye.alyosha.biography: Alosza wins by cunning where others win by strength. Every hunter knows the feather on his cap, but nobody in the forest hears Alosza himself. He smiles when the enemy thinks it is smarter.
hero.chernolesye.alyosha.name: Alosza
hero.chernolesye.alyosha.specialty.descr: Alosza's Tactics skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.alyosha.specialty.name: Tactics
hero.chernolesye.berendey.biography: Berendej was a king once, until the forest bewitched him. The oak wreath on his head has never withered since. The leszowie know him as their own, and the trees part where he walks.
hero.chernolesye.berendey.name: Berendej
hero.chernolesye.berendey.specialty.desc: Leszowie in Berendej's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.berendey.specialty.name: Leszowie
hero.chernolesye.bogomil.biography: Bogomił lives under his hood and rarely shows his face. Bird bones hang on his staff, beast bones on his neck. The wołchwowie obey his words and fall silent when he is silent.
hero.chernolesye.bogomil.name: Bogomił
hero.chernolesye.bogomil.specialty.descr: Wołchwowie in Bogomił's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.bogomil.specialty.name: Wołchwowie
hero.chernolesye.dobrynya.biography: Dobrynia once stopped a dragon with one blow of his shield and sword. Since then he wears no helmet, so enemies can see his face. He is honest and hot-tempered, and always fights ahead of his men.
hero.chernolesye.dobrynya.name: Dobrynia
hero.chernolesye.dobrynya.specialty.desc: Dobrynia's Offence skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.dobrynya.specialty.name: Offence
hero.chernolesye.ilya.biography: Ilja sat on a stove for thirty years, then stood up and went against the Nightingale the Robber. An old chainmail covers him from head to shoulders. He is stubborn and silent, and does not retreat while he stands.
hero.chernolesye.ilya.name: Ilja
hero.chernolesye.ilya.specialty.descript: Ilja's Armorer skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.ilya.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.chernolesye.krak.biography: Krak founded the town on the hill and chose every log of its wall himself. On his head is a plain iron circlet, on his shoulders a dark red cloak. People follow him calmly, because he has never lied to them.
hero.chernolesye.krak.name: Krak
hero.chernolesye.krak.specialty.descript: Krak's Leadership skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.krak.specialty.name: Leadership
hero.chernolesye.marya.biography: Marja took a sword in one hand and lightning in the other and has not known tiredness since. Her spells strike faster than the enemy can raise a shield. She laughs at those who call sorcery a woman's trade.
hero.chernolesye.marya.name: Marja
hero.chernolesye.marya.specialty.descrip: Marja's Sorcery skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.marya.specialty.name: Sorcery
hero.chernolesye.mikula.biography: Mikuła ploughs the land with a plough that ten men cannot lift. He loves bread, songs and his family, and goes to war only when ploughing is no longer possible. Gold appears wherever his boot steps.
hero.chernolesye.mikula.name: Mikuła
hero.chernolesye.mikula.specialty.descri: Mikuła's Estates skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.mikula.specialty.name: Estates
hero.chernolesye.oleg.biography: Oleg listens to what the ravens say and is in no hurry to answer. The fur hat and the snake clasp came to him from a prophetic ancestor. He knows how it will end, and still sees it through.
hero.chernolesye.oleg.name: Oleg
hero.chernolesye.oleg.specialty.descript: Oleg's Wisdom skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.oleg.specialty.name: Wisdom
hero.chernolesye.skuba.biography: Skuba is small, but cleverer than any giant. His hood is patched in ten places, and every patch hides some trick. The złydnie laugh at his jokes and follow him into fire.
hero.chernolesye.skuba.name: Skuba
hero.chernolesye.skuba.specialty.descrip: Złydnie in Skuba's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.skuba.specialty.name: Złydnie
hero.chernolesye.svyatogor.biography: Światogor is so big that moss grows on his shoulders and birds nest in his beard. The ground cannot bear his steps, so he walks carefully. The wije recognise him as their elder and wake at his word.
hero.chernolesye.svyatogor.name: Światogor
hero.chernolesye.svyatogor.specialty.des: Wije in Światogor's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.twardowski.biography: Twardowski signed a pact with the black guest long ago and does not regret it. One of his eyes burns red, and his collar is always raised. He laughs when a spell turns out better than he expected.
hero.chernolesye.twardowski.name: Twardowski
hero.chernolesye.twardowski.specialty.de: Twardowski's Mysticism skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.vasilisa.biography: Wasylisa studied with Baba Jaga and left her on the day she had learned everything. The raven on her shoulder reports all that happens in the forest. The witches obey her without words.
hero.chernolesye.vasilisa.name: Wasylisa
hero.chernolesye.vasilisa.specialty.desc: Witches in Wasylisa's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.vasilisa.specialty.name: Witches
hero.chernolesye.volga.biography: Wołga runs through the forest with the wolves and turns into a grey beast at night. The wołkołaki follow him without orders, because they think he is one of them. He walks first and never looks back.
hero.chernolesye.volga.name: Wołga
hero.chernolesye.volga.specialty.descrip: Wołkołaki in Wołga's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.volga.specialty.name: Wołkołaki
hero.chernolesye.vseslav.biography: Wsiesław was born in a caul and since then sees farther than a man should. His blue cloak is from his mother, the mark on his brow from his father. He knows where the path ends before he reaches its middle.
hero.chernolesye.vseslav.name: Wsiesław
hero.chernolesye.vseslav.specialty.descr: Wsiesław's Scouting skill grows stronger with every hero level.
hero.chernolesye.vseslav.specialty.name: Scouting
hero.chernolesye.vseslav.specialty.toolt: A wider view on the map
hero.chernolesye.yadviga.biography: Jadwiga has lived in the swamp longer than the oldest fishermen remember. Her hair is like pond slime, her eyes like still water. The bołotniki come to her on their own and ask to stay.
hero.chernolesye.yadviga.name: Jadwiga
hero.chernolesye.yadviga.specialty.descr: Bołotniki in Jadwiga's army grow stronger and faster as the hero levels up.
hero.chernolesye.yadviga.specialty.name: Bołotniki
heroClass.chernolesye.lovchij.name: Hunter
heroClass.chernolesye.vedun.name: Marsh Sorcerer
